basic_details.job_title: DRDO NPOL Consultant Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: Naval Physical and Oceanographic Laboratory (DRDO NPOL) is inviting applications for 1 Consultant vacancy on a contract basis. Eligible candidates can apply by sending their duly completed application along with required documents through post or email to Director, NPOL (DRDO), Thrikkakara P.O, Kochi from 12 October 2026 within 21 days from date of advertisement. Officers/Officials who have retired from Central/ State Government / PSUs/ Autonomous Bodies/ Universities/ Govt. R&D Organizations are eligible. content_sections.heading: DRDO NPOL Consultant at a Glance

rows.details: Naval Physical and Oceanographic Laboratory (DRDO NPOL)
Level-11 as per 7th CPC (for Pensioners/NPS) or Rs. 50,000/- per month (for Non-Pensioners)

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: The applications along with supporting documents can also be sent by email to [email protected] within the above stipulated period.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: M.Sc in Chemistry/Materials Science with experience in development and testing anti-vibration materials and testing: OR NPTEL Course Composite Manufacturing, experience in Composite fabrication, Magnetorheological mounts and shear thickening fluid based mounts & testing characterization and documentation. Experience in development of Composite/MR/STF (nananofluid) based mounts. Experience in mechanical characterization of material/Mount in UTM. Experience in material characterization equipment like DSC/TGA/DMA/FTIR. Expertise in testing of mounts in vibration shaker and pressure testing of mounts. Expertise in generation of documents like design, specification, ATP, qualification etc. Experience in carrying out formulation of rubber/composites. Experience in carrying out store procurement procedures. The maximum age limit for all categories of retired Govt. employees for applying will be 63 years as on closing date of application. content_sections.heading: DRDO NPOL Consultant Job Description
content_sections.text: The consultant is supposed to carryout following tasks: QAP tests as per trial requirement, documentation, preparation of installation manual. Assistance in finalization of ToT documents of NAVEM series, RAVM series, CAVM series, MR Mount, NAM series. Generation documents as per guidelines of technology categorization of NAVEM series, RAVM series, CAVM series, MR Mount series. Assistance in communication with directorate for formation of TACs, CECs for NAVEM series, RAVM series, CAVM series, MR Mount series and NAM series. Assistance in selection of Industries as per guidelines of DRDO ToT Policy 2025. Generation of Test results and making of ATP documents. Generation and finalization of LA ToT. Assistance in hand-holding support for the industry to absorb the technology.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Persons possessing experience of having worked with DRDO would be accorded preference during selection / appointment. No retired Government Servant shall be eligible for appointment as a Consultant unless there is a gap of fifteen (15) days between his/her retirement and appointment as Consultant.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are available for DRDO NPOL Consultant Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy available for the Consultant post under Post Code 2026/NPOL/380.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date to submit applications is 21 days from date of advertisement.

faq.question: Q3. What is the required educational qualification?
faq.answer: Candidates must have M.Sc in Chemistry/Materials Science with experience in development and testing anti-vibration materials and testing, or NPTEL Course Composite Manufacturing with experience in Composite fabrication, Magnetorheological mounts and shear thickening fluid based mounts & testing characterization and documentation.

faq.question: Q4. What is the maximum age limit to apply?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all categories of retired Govt. employees for applying will be 63 years as on closing date of application.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q6. How can I apply for this position?
faq.answer: Interested and eligible retired officials may submit their duly completed applications to the Director, NPOL (DRDO), Thrikkakara P.O, Kochi - 682 021 or by email to [email protected].

faq.question: Q7. What is the remuneration for pensioners?
faq.answer: A fixed monthly amount shall be admissible, arrived at by deducting the basic pension from the pay drawn at the time of retirement, plus a conveyance allowance of Rs. 3,000/-.

faq.question: Q8. What is the remuneration for non-pensioners?
faq.answer: Maximum consolidated monthly remuneration is Rs. 50,000/- and conveyance allowance is Rs. 3,000/-.

faq.question: Q9. What is the tenure of the contract?
faq.answer: Initially for one year and extendable as per norms.
